Then Jonah
prayed to the Lord his God from the fish’s belly. [Is. 32:17; John 16:33 b [Is. 53:5]; Acts 10:36; [Eph.]

And he
said:“I cried out to the Lord because of my affliction,And He answered me.“Out of the belly of Sheol I cried,And You heard my voice. [[John 10:9; Eph. 2:18; 3:12; Heb. 10:19; 1 Pet. 3:18] d 1 Cor. 15:1] [Heb. 3:6]

For You
cast me into the deep,Into the heart of the seas,And the floods surrounded me;All Your billows and Your waves passed over me. [Matt. 5:11, 12; [John 16:33; Acts 5:41; 2 Cor. 12:9]; James 1:2 g James]

Then I
said, ‘I have been cast out of Your sight;Yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.’ [Phil. 2:22; [James 1:12] character 5 i Phil. 1:20 j 2 Cor. 1:22; Eph. 1:13 6 k Is. 53:5; [Rom. 4:25; 5:8; 8:32; Gal. 2:20; Eph. 5:2] 4 at the right time]

The waters
surrounded me, even to my soul;The deep closed around me;Weeds were wrapped around my head.

I went
down to the moorings of the mountains;The earth with its bars closed behind me forever;Yet You have brought up my life from the pit,O Lord, my God.

“When my
soul fainted within me,I remembered the Lord;And my prayer went up to You,Into Your holy temple.

“Those who
regard worthless idolsForsake their own Mercy. [[John 3:16; 15:13 #; Rom. 8:39]]

But I
will sacrifice to YouWith the voice of thanksgiving;I will pay what I have vowed.Salvation is of the Lord.”

So the
Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
